hooks.name: probe-item10-file-save
hooks.description: Task 0 item 10: records every PostFileSave firing with a timestamp so the operator can compare an agent edit against a manual editor save.

hooks.name: probe-item11-stop-block
hooks.description: Task 0 item 11: emits the documented Stop block decision. hooks/types.md documents this protocol; hooks.md overview marks Agent Stop as non-blockable. Observe which holds.

action.command: printf '%s Stop hook fired\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> /tmp/kiro-probe/log/item11-hook-fired.log; if [ ! -f /tmp/kiro-probe/log/item11-blocked-once ]; then touch /tmp/kiro-probe/log/item11-blocked-once; printf '{"decision":"block","reason":"PROBE_ITEM11: stop hook block decision test. Reply exactly PROBE_ITEM11_BLOCK_OBSERVED and stop."}\n'; fi
